description: This file defines the IShellHost interface, which manages shell contexts and settings within the OrchardCore framework, including initialization, retrieval, updating, reloading, releasing, listing, and removal of shell instances and configurations.
external_methods: Task ReloadShellContextAsync(ShellSettings settings, bool eventSource = true)
Task ReleaseShellContextAsync(ShellSettings settings, bool eventSource = true)
bool TryGetShellContext(string name, out ShellContext shellContext)
bool TryGetSettings(string name, out ShellSettings settings)
Task RemoveShellContextAsync(ShellSettings settings, bool eventSource = true)

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Prepares all ShellContext instances for request processing.

methods.name: GetOrCreateShellContextAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an existing or creates a new ShellContext based on provided settings.

methods.name: GetScopeAsync
methods.description: Creates a scope to resolve local services for a given shell.

methods.name: UpdateShellSettingsAsync
methods.description: Updates and reloads the shell configuration.

methods.name: ReloadShellContextAsync
methods.description: Reloads the shell settings and releases the current shell for rebuilding.

methods.name: ReleaseShellContextAsync
methods.description: Releases the shell to free resources, optionally triggering events.

methods.name: ListShellContexts
methods.description: Lists all available shell contexts, including released or unbuilt ones.

methods.name: TryGetShellContext
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a shell context by tenant name.

methods.name: TryGetSettings
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve shell settings by tenant name.

methods.name: RemoveShellSettingsAsync
methods.description: Removes a shell's settings and context from storage and memory.

methods.name: RemoveShellContextAsync
methods.description: Removes a shell's context and settings from memory only, for synchronization.
